recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered surrealist composition featuring a large, semi-transparent portrait of a man integrated into a cloudy blue sky, overlooking a foreground of oversized martini glasses containing miniature figures, with a central figure reclining on a white surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale disparity between the giant background face and the miniature figures in glasses
Integration of figures with glass transparency and reflections
Juxtaposition of a serene sky background with a sterile, high-gloss white foreground
Repetition of martini glass forms creating a rhythmic middle ground
coreInvariants: Blue sky with white cumulus clouds
Semi-transparent 'ghosting' effect for the background portrait

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large scale portrait in top-left quadrant; medium scale reclining figure in bottom-left; multiple martini glasses distributed across the center and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central martini glass containing a miniature figure acts as the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large background face, moves down to the reclining figure, then follows the line of glasses toward the top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue sky provides open space in the upper half, balanced by the white reflective surface at the bottom.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep skin tones and dark hair (Subject definition)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights on glass and surfaces
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky and floor; medium saturation in the blues; high contrast on the human figures.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and extended sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal emphasis in the top line
Integration of currency symbols into letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Substitution of the letter 'S' with a stylized dollar sign featuring double vertical bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a wide, modern sans-serif and a traditional, heavy slab serif.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory warning block in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky feel of the top line.
Captures the heavy slab serif characteristics of the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal collage: A large, 40% transparent face of a man blended into a bright blue sky with white clouds. In the foreground, a glossy white floor holds several large, clear martini glasses. Inside the glasses, place miniature figures of people. In the bottom left, a woman reclines on the floor. Use high-contrast lighting and sharp focus on the foreground elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned white text in the top right corner. The top line should be a wide, bold sans-serif with a dollar sign replacing one character. Draw a thin white horizontal line below it. The second line should be a heavy slab-serif font. Add a black and white rectangular advisory badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background face properly blended into the clouds?
Are the martini glasses transparent with realistic reflections?
Is the typography right-aligned and separated by a line?
Is the dollar sign symbol correctly integrated into the word?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for scale consistency between glasses and figures
Ensure the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Verify the 'ghosting' effect doesn't obscure the text
Confirm the white floor reflections look natural
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Scale Disparity] + [Atmospheric Cloud Blending] + [High-Gloss Product Photography] + [Heavy Slab/Sans Typography Pairing].
